set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID for the only identification of a VLAN.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family ethernet-switching interface-mode.explanation: Configures the interface with trunk exchange mode.

family ethernet-switching vlan members [.explanation: Configure the VLAN members of the interface.

storm-control broadcast bandwidth-percen.explanation: The command sets a broadcast storm control threshold by limiting broadcast traffic to a specified percentage of the interface's total bandwidth.

parameters.name: bandwidth-percent
parameters.explanation: Bandwidth percentage, used to control broadcast storms.

storm-control multicast bandwidth-percen.explanation: The command sets a bandwidth percentage threshold for multicast traffic, triggering storm control when the specified percentage is exceeded to prevent network congestion.

parameters.name: bandwidth-percent
parameters.explanation: Bandwidth percentage, used to control multicast storms.

storm-control unicast bandwidth-percent.explanation: The command `storm-control unicast bandwidth-percent [parameter2]` limits unicast traffic to a specified percentage of the interface bandwidth to prevent network storms.

parameters.name: bandwidth-percent
parameters.explanation: Bandwidth percentage, used to control unicast storms.
